login.title: Sign in
login.intro: Enter the panel with your username and password.

pin.intro: Enter the PIN of {{name}} to open the panel.
pin.label: PIN
pin.format: The PIN must have 6 to 12 digits.

passkey.button: Sign in with fingerprint or PIN of this device

setup.title: Set up the second factor
setup.intro: The first sign-in needs an authenticator app (TOTP).
setup.steps: Scan the QR code with the app, open the link or add the key by hand, then type the six-digit code it shows.
setup.qrLabel: QR code for the authenticator app
setup.secretHint: Select the key to copy it.

verify.title: Verify the second factor
verify.intro: Type the six-digit code from the authenticator app.
verify.useRecovery: I do not have the app: use a recovery code

recovery.title: Save the recovery codes
recovery.intro: Each code works once, in case you lose the authenticator app.
recovery.once: This is the only time you will see them.
recovery.copyFailed: Could not copy: select them and copy by hand.
recovery.confirm: I have saved the codes somewhere safe
